description: This file defines extension methods for working with sets and dictionaries in C#. It includes methods for converting enumerables to sets, converting enumerables to strings, and retrieving or adding values in dictionaries.

classes.name: SetExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for set and dictionary operations.

methods.name: ToSet
methods.description: Creates a HashSet from an IEnumerable, supporting type inference.

methods.name: ToStrings
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable to a concatenated string of its elements, with optional custom string conversion and separator.

methods.name: GetValueOrAddNew
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a dictionary by key, or adds a new default instance if the key does not exist.
